roster.name: Observations Data Model 2 (ODM2)
roster.description: A community information model and relational schema for spatially-discrete, feature-based Earth observations (core entities: Actions, Results, SamplingFeatures, Variables, Units, etc.), with extensions (Equipment, LabAnalyses, Provenance, Results), controlled vocabularies, best-practice guidance, SQL schema scripts, and a software ecosystem (Python API, REST services, admin tools).

roster.name: OGC Observations & Measurements (O&M) / ISO 19156
roster.description: The Open Geospatial Consortium / ISO standard for representing observations and sampling features (Observations & Measurements, ISO 19156). ODM2 is explicitly described as a profile of OGC O&M and cites O&M/ISO 19156 implementation and XML specs.

roster.name: YODA (YAML Observation Data Archive & exchange) File Format
roster.description: A YAML-based file format defined in the ODM2 ecosystem for encoding and exchanging ODM2 datasets (YODA-File repository, with YODA-Tools for validation and utilities).

roster.name: SKOS / RDF exposure for controlled vocabularies
roster.description: Use of SKOS (Simple Knowledge Organization System) and RDF/XML to publish ODM2 controlled vocabularies via a RESTful API (vocabulary.odm2.org), providing term URIs and machine-readable vocabulary representations.
